list.caption: Platform clubs

localization.confirmIntro: Before saving, review what changes for the club:

consequences.countryProfile: The country profile changes how the club's forms validate documents, postal codes and taxes.
consequences.currency: The currency changes from {from} to {to}: current prices are not converted and the plans will need a review.
consequences.defaultLocale: Texts missing in a language will be shown in the new default language.
consequences.localesAdded: The club's texts (pages, templates, questions) will need completing in the new languages.
consequences.localesRemoved: Members will no longer be able to choose {locales}; texts in that language are kept but not shown.
consequences.timeZone: The time zone changes from {from} to {to}: every schedule of the club will be read in the new zone.

localization.currencyHelp: Three-letter ISO code, for example EUR.
localization.defaultNotListed: The default language must be one of the club's languages.
localization.description: Changes in this tab affect the whole club: their consequences are shown before saving.
localization.title: Localization

modulesTab.description: Turn the club's modules on. Each module says what it turns on and what it depends on.
modulesTab.noDataLoss: Turning a module off deletes no data: turned on again, everything shows again.
modulesTab.title: Modules

parameters.note: Each parameter shows its default value; a value you save here is shown until you leave the tab.

payments.billingOff: The Billing module is off: providers can be configured but are not used until it is turned on.

manual.defaultRequired: The text in the club's default language is required.
manual.description: Instructions to pay in cash or by transfer, shown at signup.
manual.title: Manual payment

payments.removeConfirm: Its configuration will be deleted. If members use it, it cannot be removed.

sepa.ibanHelpNew: Write-only: once saved it is never shown again.
sepa.ibanHelpStored: Stored IBAN: {masked}. Leave it blank to keep it.
sepa.title: SEPA direct debit

stripe.publishableHelp: The publishable key (pk_…). It must be typed again on each save.
stripe.title: Stripe

payments.writeOnly: Write-only: once saved it is never shown again.
payments.writeOnlyKept: Saved. Leave it blank to keep it.

processes.description: The club's automatic processes, their last run and their health. They can be simulated or run now.
processes.empty: The club has no active process.
processes.title: Processes

record.created: The club {name} was created. Complete the onboarding checklist to activate it.

statusTab.checklistComplete: The onboarding checklist is complete: the club can be activated.
statusTab.checklistIncomplete: Checklist items are still missing: {items}. The club can be activated anyway.
statusTab.description: Activation is always manual. Every status change is audited.

meaning.ONBOARDING: The club already works and its administrators see an onboarding banner.
meaning.SUSPENDED: Access to the club is refused and processes do not run.

statusTab.suspendEffects: On suspension: access to the club is refused, automatic processes are skipped and online payments queue until it is reactivated.
statusTab.title: Status

team.caption: Club administrators

team.empty: The club has no administrator yet.
team.inviteHelp: The account is created if needed, given the administrator role, and gets an access link by email.
team.name: Name
team.removeConfirm: They will no longer administer the club. Their data and account are kept.
team.title: Team

theme.contrastBlocked: Some colours lack contrast: fix them before saving.
theme.contrastFailure: Contrast {ratio}:1 on «{background}»: at least 4.5:1 is needed.
theme.logosHelp: The club's images. The logo is used on the access screens; the mark, in the header.
theme.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded.

usage.description: The month's aggregate counters; the console shows no member data.
usage.title: Usage

wizard.adminHelp: They will get an email invitation with an access link as the club's administrator.

presetHelp.COMPLET: Every module but statistics and social league.
